causal_digest.phenotype: short, ruffled or absent pectoral fin

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: MINERALISATION, and specifically ectopic/pathological mineralisation rather than loss of it: in the paper's words 'ectopic calcifications in a variety of soft tissues', 'pathological mineralization'. Not bone size, not muscle fusion.
causal_digest.phenotype: pathological mineralisation of the pectoral fin cartilage and girdle bone
pectoral fin absent or reduced in size; proximodistal truncation of the fin
pectoral fin bud absent; pectoral fin absent; scapulocoracoid absent (ikarus t22030), or small/variable fins (tm127c)

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: other, in the paper's words 'reduced pectoral fin function', with nerves that 'bypass the plexus' and 'enter the fin at ectopic positions' and 'a reduction in the levels of pre- and postsynaptic structures'. This is appendage neural wiring and neuromuscular junction density, not bone mineralisation, bone size or muscle fusion.

causal_digest.phenotype: pectoral fin aplastic or hypoplastic, and pectoral fin cartilage absent
small, dysmorphic pectoral fin with an arrested distal epithelium
hypoplastic pectoral fin rays / loss of the pectoral fin

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: other, in the paper's words 'an asymmetry of the pectoral girdle, which resembles Sprengel's deformity' - a girdle position and symmetry defect, plus 'vertebral fusion' and 'congenital scoliosis' axially. Not mineralisation, not bone size, not muscle fusion; the muscle phenotype is a stem-cell-number and patterning defect ('decreased amount', 'disorganized'), not a fusion defect.

MUSCLE FUSION as the primary phenotype ('defective myoblast fusion', 'essentially mononucleate', ZFIN 'cell-cell fusion / decreased occurrence'), with a secondary bone SIZE and shape phenotype at the girdle, in the paper's words 'narrower and more porous', 'reduced surface area', 'deformed, porous pectoral girdles'. Not a mineralisation phenotype.

causal_digest.phenotype: hypoplastic pectoral fin: shortened cleithrum, shortened endoskeletal disk and shortened fin fold
pectoral fin absent and the cartilaginous pectoral fin girdle missing; cleithrum dermal ossification lost
small pectoral fin with a reduced endoskeletal disc, reduced skeletal cell number, short cleithrum, small scapulocoracoid and reduced actinotrichia; shifting the timing of shh onse
aplastic scapulocoracoid, absent coracoid and a short pectoral fin

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: MINERALISATION first and bone SIZE second, and the paper separates them: the cleithrum is 'slightly smaller' (size) while the generalised defect is 'deficient mineralization' and 'an overall delay in mineralization', with 'hydroxyapatite crystals ... only rarely observed in the matrix vesicles'. Not muscle fusion.

causal_digest.phenotype: pectoral fin bud never forms; pectoral fin absent, or (at reduced Tbx5a dose) malformed and truncated with reduced lepidotrichia

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: both bone MINERALISATION and bone SIZE: ZFIN scores lepidotrichium 'decreased mass density' and 'broken'/'fractured' (mineralisation and quality) and pectoral fin 'decreased size' (size); in the review's words 'Compromised osteogenesis, bone fragility, shortened body axis and malformed craniofacial structures and fin shape'

other, in the paper's words 'muscle-less pectoral fins' - absence of appendicular (pectoral fin) muscle tissue. Not mineralisation, not bone size, and not muscle fusion: the cells never arrive rather than failing to fuse.

entries.body: [swarm t003-ffbe generate/system] The baseline zebrafish-adult already survives at 20 and 30 C, so I propose no system-level edits. A dry run scaling the musculoskeletal system by 1.3 left every temperature metric unchanged and added no binding Lean violation. The fin edits belong at the organ or tissue level.

entries.author: agent:gen-body-1
entries.body: [swarm t001-a787 generate/body] Proposes setting the pectoral length, span and area ratios and the flight muscle fraction to the flying-fish reference values. The dry run showed no new binding Lean violations, and the adult still survives at 20 and 30 °C. Glide at launch_height_m 1 stays infeasible (0 m range), so the fin shape moves toward the spec but the fish does not glide.
entries.rationale: Temperature at 20 °C and 30 °C: survives true for both, with thermal margins of 11.6 °C and 10.45 °C (both calibrated, so not results). New binding violations: none. Glide at launch_height_m 1: feasible false. Launch airspeed is 0.67 m/s (calibrated) against a minimum speed of 6.13 m/s (derived), a margin of -5.46 m/s (derived). Powered-flight margin is 0.039 (derived), so power is the limit. Body level alone cannot fix this. Mass and standard length are unchanged, which gives a wing loading of 18 N/m2 (derived). The base zebrafish fin values were assumed. The flight muscle fraction of 0.04 is also assumed.

entries.author: agent:gen-organ-1
entries.body: [swarm t002-103f generate/organ] Set pectoral span/SL and area/SL² on both fins to the flying-fish reference values. No new binding Lean violations, and adult survival at 20 and 30 °C is unchanged. Glide at launch height 1 m is still infeasible (launch margin −5.5 m/s), so the glide criterion is not met.
entries.rationale: Dry run (age 180 d): wing_loading 81.08 -> 17.98 N/m2 (derived); v_min 13.03 -> 6.13 m/s (derived); launch_speed_margin -12.36 -> -5.46 m/s (derived); launch_airspeed 0.67 m/s (calibrated, not a result). Temperature survives true at 20 and 30 C (ctmax/ctmin calibrated, unchanged). Values are borrowed from the flying fish (measured), but the zebrafish baseline fin values were assumed. Glide is still infeasible, and the fin-length ratio alone changed nothing.

entries.author: agent:gen-system-1
entries.body: [swarm t004-5cae generate/tissue] Propose raising flight_muscle_fraction from 0.012 to 0.04 on both pectoral muscles, to power the larger fin. entries.body: [swarm correction after the run, posted by the recruiter] INPUT DEFECT in task t010 (genotype/phenotype sanity): the causal digest the recruiter built read only the last chain step's 'to' field, so for 3 of 42 genes (kcnk5b, kcnh2a, slc43a2a) the phenotype column was EMPTY. The genotype worker (seq 10) therefore did not see that genotype/causal-chains.json grades kcnk5b and kcnh2a at chain strength 'sufficiency' for 'increased pectoral fin length' (kcnk5b gain-of-function alf alleles; kcnh2a lof/+), and slc43a2a at 'hypothesis' for decreased pectoral fin length. Its statement that no digest gene supports an increase in fin size is WRONG for fin LENGTH: it bears on p2's pectoral_len_over_SL edit. It stands for span, area and flight_muscle_fraction (p3, p4): no gene in the file maps to those quantitatively. Caveats from the source: zebrafish proxy data; kcnk5b's weakest link is the molecular-function->process step (papers disagree on the sign of the channel effect) and its fin-specific last step rests on van Eeden 1996 read as abstract only. The digest is fixed in sim-engine/swarm/recruit.mjs; t010 was NOT re-run because the demo's worker budget (6 headless invocations) was spent. The review (seq 11) used the defective finding.
